<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Organization</a></td>
<td class="text"> <div style="font-size: 8pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><div style="font-size: 8pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">&#160;</div></div> <div style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">1. Organization </div></div> <div style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">HarbourVest Private Equity Secondaries Fund L.P. (the &#8220;Partnership&#8221;) is a Delaware limited partnership formed on September 29, 2025, and is a private investment fund exempt from registration pursuant to Section&#160;3(c)(7) of the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended. The Partnership commenced operations on March 2, 2026. </div></div> <div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"></div><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;"></div> <div style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;text-indent: 0px;"><div style="display:inline;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">The general partner of the Partnership is HarbourVest GP LLC, a Delaware <div style="display:inline;">limited</div> liability company (the &#8220;General Partner&#8221;). The General Partner is authorized to establish additional classes or series of Units with such terms, rights and obligations as determined in the sole discretion of the General Partner without receiving consent from the Limited Partners. The General Partner has authorized the Partnership to appoint HarbourVest Partners L.P. (the &#8220;Manager&#8221;), a Delaware limited partnership, to manage the affairs of the Partnership. The General Partner and the Manager are affiliates of HarbourVest Partners, LLC. </div></div></div> <div style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">The Partnership&#8217;s investment objective is to deliver capital growth over the medium to long term through direct or indirect exposure to the equity and debt of primarily private businesses, across geographies, sectors and stages primarily through secondary investments (&#8220;Secondary Investments&#8221;) and complemented by certain primary partnership investments (&#8220;Primary Partnership Investments&#8221;), in the private equity space, with the potential to generate medium- to long-term outperformance compared to public markets while striving to limit volatility and downside risk. </div></div> <div style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">The Partnership invests all or substantially all of its assets through its investment in HSEC Holdings, L.P. (the &#8220;Aggregator&#8221;). The Aggregator has the same investment objectives as the Partnership. The financial statements of the Aggregator should be read in conjunction with the Partnership&#8217;s financial statements and are included following these financial statements. As of June&#160;30, 2026 and March&#160;31, 2026, the Partnership has 0.1% and 0.2% ownership interest in the Aggregator, respectively. </div></div> <div style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">The Partnership has entered into a limited partnership agreement, as amended and restated, with the General Partner. Under the terms of the Aggregator&#8217;s Partnership Agreement, overall responsibility for the Aggregator&#8217;s oversight rests with the General Partner. </div></div> <div style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">The Partnership has entered into an investment management agreement with the Manager (as may be further amended and restated from time to time, the &#8220;Management Agreement&#8221;). </div></div> <span></span>
</td>
</tr>

<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Organization</a></td>
<td class="text"><div style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 18pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">1. Organization </div></div><div style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">HSEC Holdings L.P. (the &#8220;Aggregator&#8221;) is a Delaware limited partnership formed on September 29, 2025 and is a private investment fund exempt from registration pursuant to Section&#160;3(c)(7) of the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended. The Aggregator commenced operations on March 2, 2026 (&#8220;Commencement of Operations&#8221;). The Aggregator offers Limited Partner Interests (&#8220;Interests&#8221;). </div></div><div style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">The general partner of the Aggregator is HarbourVest GP LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the &#8220;General Partner&#8221;). The General Partner is authorized to establish additional classes or series of Interests with such terms, rights and obligations as determined in the sole discretion of the General Partner without receiving consent from the Limited Partners. The General Partner has authorized HarbourVest Partners L.P. (the &#8220;Manager&#8221;), a Delaware limited partnership, to manage the affairs of the Aggregator. The General Partner and the Manager are affiliates of HarbourVest Partners, LLC. HarbourVest Private Equity Secondaries Fund L.P. and HarbourVest Private Equity Secondaries Cayman Parallel Fund L.P. are limited partners of the Aggregator (the &#8220;Limited Partners&#8221;). New Limited Partners may be admitted to the Aggregator at any time with consent of the General Partner and without approval of any Limited Partner. </div></div><div style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">The Aggregator&#8217;s investment objective is to deliver capital growth over the medium to long term through direct or indirect exposure to the equity and debt of primarily private businesses, across geographies, sectors and stages primarily through secondary investments (&#8220;Secondary Investments&#8221;) and complemented by certain primary partnership investments (&#8220;Primary Partnership Investments&#8221;), in the private equity space, with the potential to generate medium- to long-term outperformance compared to public markets while striving to limit volatility and downside risk. </div></div><div style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">The Aggregator has entered into a limited partnership agreement as amended and restated with the General Partner. Under the terms of the Aggregator&#8217;s Partnership Agreement, overall responsibility for the Aggregator&#8217;s oversight rests with the General Partner. </div></div><span></span>
</td>
</tr>
